_doc: Buffs (on yourself) and debuffs (on the foe) from status moves. Every one has a cost (tit for tat; BATTLE_IDEAS.md 3). Strength 0..1 from how long the move was channelled scales the numbers marked *s (min 0.25). time: seconds; buffs lose `hit_drain` seconds per hit taken, debuffs just run out. then: an effect that follows when it ends (Lethargy after Sprint). mods: speed, dealt, taken (multipliers, 1 + value x strength), no_dodge, hidden (foes lose track; attacking ends it), crit_first (the first hit taken is a critical).
